name: node-engine-sdk-workspace

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:playground
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @node-engine-sdk/core && npm run build -w @node-engine-sdk/vue && npm run build -w @node-engine-sdk/react && npm run build -w @node-engine-sdk/presets
scripts.build:playground: npm run typecheck:playground && vite build playground --config playground/config/vite.config.ts && vite build playground-react --config playground-react/config/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @node-engine-sdk/core && npm run build -w @node-engine-sdk/vue && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:playground
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck -w @node-engine-sdk/core && npm run typecheck -w @node-engine-sdk/vue && npm run typecheck -w @node-engine-sdk/react && npm run typecheck -w @node-engine-sdk/presets
scripts.typecheck:playground: tsc -p playground-shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p playground/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p playground-react/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.verify: npm run quality && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run pack:all && npm run test:packed

description: Node Engine SDK: a framework-agnostic node graph SDK with official Vue 3 and React adapters
